QuestInfo.name: Where Tristan Stood
QuestInfo.0: #b#p502##k has one last thing to ask of me.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p502##k says a #r#o700001##k now holds #m10005105#, the place where Tristan made his last stand. I need to defeat the #r#o700001##k.
QuestInfo.2: I defeated the #r#o700001##k. But the eyes by #b#p502##k's fire didn't go dark. They burned brighter. #b#p502##k says it was only the guard at the door.

0.0: The eyes are still glowing. The guards were not the source.
0.1: Deep in #m10005105# lives a #r#o700001##k. It is not the Balrog itself, but it was born from the Balrog's darkness. And it sits where Tristan made his last stand.
0.2: I can't fight it anymore. But you can. Defeat the #r#o700001##k. And bring friends. Don't fight it alone, like he did.

yes.0: #m10005105# is past the Sanctuary Entrance. Go with friends, and come back alive.

no.0: Hmph. Maybe that's wise. Come back when you're ready.

1.0: You did it? Then why... Look at the eyes. They're brighter than before.
1.1: That #r#o700001##k wasn't what made them glow. It was only the guard at the door. The Balrog itself still sleeps, deeper than any of us have gone.
1.2: Tristan stood there once, and he never came back. You did. That's enough for today. Take this, and keep getting stronger. When the time comes, I'll need you.

mob.0: The eyes are still glowing. Defeat the #r#o700001##k in #m10005105#.
